title: Pub Trivia Night at The Brass Anchor
description: Six rounds of smart, funny pub trivia with Kingston's busiest trivia crew. Free to play, prizes for the podium, table service all night. Teams up to 6 — come early, tables go fast.

title: Music Bingo at Division Taphouse
description: It's bingo, but the numbers are bangers. Mark your card when you hear the song — first line wins. Free entry, themed rounds every week, and yes, you can sing along.

title: Murder Mystery Night at Limestone Brewing Co.
description: Someone at this brewery is not who they say they are. Work your table through clues, evidence rounds, and alibis to name the culprit — no acting required, you play yourself. 90 minutes, fully hosted, ticket includes your first clue packet.

title: Hosted Comedy Night at The Crown & Cask
description: A hosted comedy format with improv games, audience rounds, and a running MC — funny even when nobody famous is in town. Ten bucks, big laughs, mid-week therapy.

title: Fantasy Tavern Night at Gaslight Brewery
description: For one night, the brewery is a medieval tavern. Take a persona card at the door, pick up quests, play tavern games, and drink like an adventurer. Costumes welcome, never required. Hosted by the Guildmaster.

title: Karaoke Saturdays at King's Landing Sports Bar
description: Full-production karaoke with a real host, themed rounds, duet drafts, and song games between singers. Free to sing, impossible to leave early.

title: Puzzle Quest Sundays at The Common House Café
description: A lazy-Sunday puzzle hunt: ciphers, logic challenges, and a table-vs-table clue race with coffee in hand. Free to play, all skill levels, teams formed on arrival.

title: Open Mic Monday at Harbour House
description: Music, comedy, poetry — five-minute slots, sign up at the door, warm hosted room. The Monday night Kingston didn't know it had.
